main_text.head: ROBERTI ROLLOCI IN EPISTOLAM PAULI APOSTOLI POSTERIOREM AD Thessalonicenses COMMENTARIUS.
CAPUT I.
ARGUMENTUM.
main_text.p: Hoc capite primùm est salutatio, duobus primis versi-bus; deinde est exordium gratulatorium sive εὐχαριστήριον[?], ad versum usq; 5. Ubi arreptâ occasione ex loco proximo, in quo de afflictionibus dixit, aggreditur tertiam capitis partem, qua consolatur Thessalonicenses adversus afflictiones ad verf. 11. ubi consolationem proximam concludit precibus, ad finem cap.

Aulus[?] & Sylvanus] Cùm non modò res eadem sit, sed verba etiam plané eadem in salutatione huic epistolæ præfixâ, cum iis quæ fuerunt in salutatione illâ quæ superiori ad Thessalonicenses epistolæ præmissa est; ideo lectorem ad ea quæ diximus in salutationem superioris epistolæ remittimus.
3 Gratias agere debemus Deo semper de vobis, fratres,

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "Cùm" is ornamental and hard to identify; it is read as the first letter of the paragraph. The Greek word "εὐχαριστήριον" is uncertain in its first letters and accents. The lemma "Aulus" is uncertain: the verse line above reads "Paulus", and the scan is faint at this point. The title block is set in spaced capitals, read as one level-1 heading. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
